::: {.ai-section}
## A traceable preparation workflow

::: {.ai-grid}
::: {.ai-card}
### Transaction categorization

Apply documented rules to suggest categories and flag ambiguous transactions instead of guessing.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Receipt collection

Search approved sources for receipts and invoices, then connect each document to the relevant
transaction.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Document matching

Compare amounts, dates, vendors, and reference numbers while preserving the source document for
review.
:::
::: {.ai-card}
### Exception review

Separate routine matches from missing, conflicting, or unusual items that need a person to decide.
:::
:::

::: {.ai-policy}
Bookkeeping automation prepares and documents suggestions. A responsible person reviews
categorizations and approves any record change or payment action.
:::
